codex.hollowbell.list_nobook: You're not holding the book, so the list does nothing.
codex.hollowbell.list_in_force: In force: he leaves these %s alone.
codex.hollowbell.list_off: Not in force: someone nearer him has the book.
codex.hollowbell.hunted: He's hunting you for %s more days.
codex.hollowbell.move_tip.grab: A strand takes what you look at and pulls it up into the dome.
codex.hollowbell.move_tip.harvest: A strand pulls up a creature or a tree under him.
codex.hollowbell.move_tip.curtain: The strands close in round what you look at and pull tight.
codex.hollowbell.move_tip.sweep: All the strands swing across the ground.
codex.hollowbell.move_tip.arm_slam: An arm lifts and slaps down.
codex.hollowbell.move_tip.arm_wrap: An arm curls round what you look at and squeezes.
codex.hollowbell.move_tip.pulse_wave: A hard pulse: a shock ring, knockback and nausea, and flyers fall.
codex.hollowbell.move_tip.drop: The bell lifts and glows, then the whole of him comes down on the ground. A huge blow round him.
codex.hollowbell.move_tip.shed: Egg clumps drop off and hatch into Bellings.
being.hollowbell.title: Riding him
message.hollowbell.codex_none: No Hollowbell within reach of the book.
message.hollowbell.codex_lost: You need the book on you.
message.hollowbell.codex_cannot_attack: He can't do that right now.
message.hollowbell.codex_cannot_ride: He can't carry you right now.
message.hollowbell.codex_coming: He's coming to pick you up. Stand still under him.
message.hollowbell.codex_let_go: He lets go of everything he's holding.
message.hollowbell.codex_not_yours: Only an operator can change that.
message.hollowbell.codex_nothing_there: You're not looking at a creature.
message.hollowbell.codex_slow: He takes his time about it.
message.hollowbell.codex_spared: He leaves %s alone while you hold the book.
message.hollowbell.codex_spared_kind: He leaves every %s alone while you hold the book.
message.hollowbell.codex_turned: He won't listen to you any more.
message.hollowbell.codex_winded: He hasn't got the wind for that.
message.hollowbell.compass_away_going: Nobody's near him, so he's out of the world, drifting to %s, %s (about %s min left). He comes back when you get near.
message.hollowbell.compass_away_still: Nobody's near him, so he's out of the world, holding still. He comes back when you get near.
message.hollowbell.codex_away_sent: He's %s blocks off, out of the world. He heads for %s, %s (about %s min).
message.hollowbell.codex_far_away: He's too far off for that. Call him to you first.
message.hollowbell.had_enough: The Hollowbell has had enough of you. The book won't keep him off you now.
message.hollowbell.lets_it_go: He lets it go. %s more and he stops listening to the book.
message.hollowbell.grabbed: A strand has you! Hit it to make it let go.
message.hollowbell.inside: You're inside the dome. Hit the glowing spots over you.
message.hollowbell.knocked_down: The pulse knocks you out of the air!
message.hollowbell.on_crown: You're riding him. WASD to drift, Jump and Sneak to go up and down, the keys on the left for moves, G to get off.
command.hollowbell.bad_mood: Mood must be calm, hunting or guardian.
advancements.hollowbell.slay.title: Rung Out
advancements.hollowbell.inside.title: Under Glass
advancements.hollowbell.inside.descripti: Get pulled up inside a Hollowbell's dome
command.hollowbell.done_heal: Healed him and grew his pods back.
codex.hollowbell.parts_sunk: Pods %s of %s: he's lost his lift
message.hollowbell.sunk: Too many pods popped: he's lost his lift and sinks to the ground!
command.hollowbell.done_height: He'll drift at that height for a while.
codex.hollowbell.move_tip.sting_volley: The strand ends nearest you flick three rounds of stingers at you. Poison and slowness.
codex.hollowbell.move_tip.strand_lash: One strand winds back and whips sideways through everything on that side of him.
codex.hollowbell.move_tip.glow_flash: Every glowing part flares at once: blindness and darkness, and far worse at night.
codex.hollowbell.move_tip.spore_cloud: Egg clumps burst into clouds of poison that drift after you.
codex.hollowbell.move_tip.pod_burst: Every pod swells and sprays poison goo straight down.
codex.hollowbell.move_tip.egg_rain: Egg clumps drop off and burst where they land. Some hatch into Bellings.
codex.hollowbell.move_tip.whirlpool: He spins, and his strands drag everything in a wide ring in under him, then crush it.
codex.hollowbell.move_tip.sky_dive: He climbs very high, turns over and dives bell first. A huge shock wave where he lands.
codex.hollowbell.move_tip.deep_toll: Three tolls, louder each time, then a massive shock ring. Throws everything far and breaks glass and leaves.
codex.hollowbell.move_tip.arm_storm: All eight arms go up, then crash down one after another all round him.
codex.hollowbell.move_tip.stinger_storm: Every strand flicks stingers up, and they rain down over a wide area.
codex.hollowbell.move_tip.sun_lances: A beam of burning light from each glowing spot sweeps out over the ground. One hunts you.
codex.hollowbell.move_tip.undertow: His strands spread wide and drag everything round him in, then slam it down.
warn.hollowbell.whirlpool: A whirlpool is starting under him!
warn.hollowbell.sky_dive: He's climbing for a sky dive!
warn.hollowbell.stinger_storm: His stingers are rattling: a storm is coming!
warn.hollowbell.sun_lances: His glowing spots are burning brighter!
warn.hollowbell.undertow: An undertow is starting: get away from him!
codex.hollowbell.tier_tip.light: Quick and cheap. He can do these often.
codex.hollowbell.tier_tip.medium: A clear warning, then a real hit.
codex.hollowbell.tier_tip.heavy: Rare and huge. Long warning, wide area. Wears him out for a few seconds.
message.hollowbell.worn_out: He's worn out. Give him a few seconds.
command.hollowbell.detail_is_on: Detail is on: far away he's drawn simpler, so he runs faster.
command.hollowbell.detail_is_off: Detail is off: he's always drawn in full, however far away.
command.hollowbell.detail_on: Detail on: far away he'll be drawn simpler, so he runs faster.
command.hollowbell.detail_off: Detail off: he'll always be drawn in full, however far away.
command.hollowbell.away_going: Out of the world, about %s %s (%s), drifting to %s %s, %s min left. Size %s, health %s/%s
command.hollowbell.away_still: Out of the world at about %s %s (%s), holding still. Size %s, health %s/%s
command.hollowbell.away_is_on: Away is on: with nobody within %s blocks he steps out of the world and keeps going. %s out there now.
command.hollowbell.away_is_off: Away is off: he stays in the world. (%s blocks when on, %s out there now.)
